title: calystegia fulcrata subsp. pedicellata
intro: Calystegia fulcrata subsp. pedicellata, commonly known as the Mexican morning glory, is a perennial vine in the Convolvulaceae family. The Mexican morning glory has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, helping to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the nervous system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Calystegia fulcrata subsp. pedicellata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
